row.proto: NeVecU32 *Sess_Build_SelectableDriverList(NeVecU32 *out, void *ctx, void *entrants, const void *filter, void *alloc, uint8_t flag)
row.notes: Builds the list of selectable driver ids (u32 = id<<16 | sub) into out {alloc,begin,end,cap}, alloc from the 5th argument. Uses entrants+0xe10/+0xe18 lists and flags +0xe20..+0xe25, the 0x48-byte identity filter (Sess_Match_EntrantIdentity_Thunk 0x1431146d0), Sess_Entrant_PassesFilter 0x1424a0a90 (ctx as filter context), Ent_Get_Driver_Thunk 0x1423dbcf0 and push helper 0x1424a0db0. Override: Game.driverSelectOverride read once via Ne_Config_GetString 0x143a44700 on [g_Game_Manager+0x40]+0x18, default empty string, cached in 0x14606ea44 (flag 0x14606ea48). A non-empty value is a driver label looked up in GDB entrants.drivers (Gdb_Find_RowByLabel 0x1445a2bd0, Gdb_Get_FieldInt 0x1445a2cf0 stat_id) -> id = stat_id<<16. If that id is in the built list the list is cut to that single driver. Returns out. Callers: Sess_Build_ChampionshipEntrantSelection 0x140ba4390, 0x1407a38e0, 0x142459900, 0x14310ead0. hidden-modes 2026-11-13 (vmknolle-hidden-a): read from the Ghidra decompile.
